{{Quote|A chalarax can't change its spots.|Atris|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A '''chalarax''' was a [[Species/Legends|creature]] that had spots. It could not change them, and, based on that fact, sometime before<ref name="Revan" /> [[3954 BBY]]<ref name="date">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' indicates that the events depicted in the first part of the novel take place two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> a proverb had been formulated.<ref name="Revan" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="date" /> when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Atris]] refused to let go of her distrust for fellow Master [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] despite the former's redemption from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] [[3956 BBY|two years earlier]], she quoted the proverb, comparing Revan to a chalarax.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The chalarax was mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', published in [[2011]].<ref name="Revan" />
